title: Gowers half expectation
statement: Let $F$ be a real-valued family on pairs consisting of a binary vector of length $k+1$ and a point of the $n$-dimensional binary cube. Choose a coordinate $i\in\{0,\ldots,k\}$, a bit $b\in\mathbb{F}_2$, and a $k$-tuple $y$ of points of the $n$-dimensional binary cube. The Gowers half expectation is the uniform average, over all points $x$ of that cube, of the Gowers half product at $x$ for the chosen $F,i,b,y$.
caveat: The definition of the Gowers cube point used inside the half product is not included in the supplied payload.
